evidence_basis: code read and line-checked on main; no tests run; no live probe

executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Tool selection is an English-only regex gate and 'no tool ran' is enforced only in prompt text, so the agent can claim actions that never happened.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Code-gate unbacked action claims (A1) and add a bilingual/follow-up-aware planning gate (A2).

scope.target_name: AURA aura_backend AIKernel turn pipeline (run + stream) and its chat client
model_stack: Ollama qwen2.5:3b on the VPS target

supersedes_earlier_claims.claim: semantic answer cache not keyed on retrieved documents or memory

findings.title: 'No tool ran' is enforced only by prompt text
findings.mechanism: When planning is skipped or fails, the only control on the answer claiming an action is prompt prose (PLANNING_FAILED_NOTE, _CORE_IDENTITY); the note is added only when planning raised.
findings.root_cause: No post-generation check correlates action claims with succeeded side-effecting steps; no degraded reason exists for it.
findings.recommended_fix: Kernel check in run and stream: action claim without a succeeded side-effecting step or pending confirmation -> revision frame and/or degraded reason 'unbacked_action_claim'.
acceptance: Planning-skipped turn answering 'I've added the task' yields degraded_reasons containing unbacked_action_claim
A succeeded propose_task turn is not flagged

findings.title: Planning gate is English-only and the planner sees only the current message
findings.mechanism: needs_plan returns False for <40-char messages and messages without English markers; Arabic imperatives and follow-ups never plan, so no tool can run. goal_from_message uses only the current message.
findings.root_cause: Regex heuristics tuned for English; no conversational context passed to the planner.
findings.recommended_fix: Arabic intent/marker patterns or a cheap classifier when tools are offered; include last assistant turn in the goal; plan after a turn that offered an action.
acceptance: needs_plan True for >=5 Arabic imperatives per propose_* tool
Follow-up 'yes, add it' plans when prior turn offered an action

findings.severity_note: high on the VPS target (400-token default cap), low on Railway (4096)
findings.title: Tool output can be dropped by the prompt budget with no note to the model
findings.mechanism: Tool results are non-pinned context items; pack() may drop them; _execution_notes only covers unexecuted/failed steps, so a succeeded-but-dropped result reaches generation as nothing.
findings.root_cause: assemble() does not report dropped tool items; no TOOL_OUTPUT reservation.
findings.recommended_fix: Pinned note per dropped tool result, or minimum TOOL_OUTPUT share; degraded reason 'tool_output_dropped'.
acceptance: At 400-token cap with a 2k-token tool result, prompt holds a marked truncation or the pinned note, never neither

findings.title: History hole: messages 5-20 are neither shown nor summarised
findings.mechanism: Prompt keeps last 4 messages; episodic summary starts only after 20 messages and covers only what falls beyond the 12-message window.
findings.root_cause: Two independently configured windows (prompt_history_messages=4, episodic_window=12, summarise_after_turns=20) with no omission marker.
findings.recommended_fix: Summarise everything older than the prompt window, or add an explicit 'earlier messages omitted' marker.
acceptance: 8-exchange test with defaults: every exchange is verbatim, summarised, or covered by an explicit omission marker

findings.title: History summary sits on the SYSTEM channel; its fallback is raw unmarked transcript
findings.mechanism: Model-written summary of user+assistant text (which may quote DATA) is inserted as SYSTEM; summariser failure inserts the last 4000 chars of raw transcript, unmarked despite the docstring.
findings.root_cause: Summary treated as operator-trusted; fallback marker never implemented; summaries fold previous summaries.
findings.recommended_fix: Summary on DATA (fenced) or a described own-notes channel; mark the fallback; carry taint into the summary.
acceptance: Summary item channel is not SYSTEM
Fallback text starts with an explicit marker

findings.title: Guarded input used for one turn; raw message stored and replayed
findings.mechanism: guard_input may strip invisible/tag characters or truncate; kernel stores request.message (original) in history, and history is never re-guarded; the reasoner also gets the raw message.
findings.root_cause: _history_message and ReasoningRequest use request.message instead of the guarded message.
findings.recommended_fix: Persist and pass the guarded text.
acceptance: Message with Unicode tag-block chars: stored history equals the guarded text

findings.title: A corrected fact can be swallowed as a duplicate of the old one
findings.mechanism: remember() merges any same-kind memory at cosine >= 0.94 by keeping the old text and raising its confidence.
findings.root_cause: No contradiction/supersede path; similarity treated as identity.
findings.confidence_note: needs an embedding probe on real pairs
findings.recommended_fix: Supersede the old record when texts differ; reinforce only on equal/entailed text; recall prefers newer of conflicting records.
acceptance: Opt-in real-embedder test: 'manager is Sara' then 'manager is Omar' recalls Omar

findings.title: Model-authored memory writes governed only by a tool description
findings.mechanism: remember_fact stores the planner-written fact; 'only user-stated facts' is description text; provenance does not record support in the user message; confirmation only on tainted turns.
findings.root_cause: No code check of the fact against the user's message; recall ignores provenance.
findings.recommended_fix: Require support in the guarded user message; tag user_stated/model_inferred and rank accordingly.
acceptance: Unsupported fact is refused or stored with confidence < 0.5 and model_inferred

findings.title: Empty generation without tool calls ends as a silent success
findings.mechanism: Stream substitutes fallback text only when tool calls were seen; otherwise done/SUCCESS with an empty answer persisted to history; run has no check.
findings.recommended_fix: Treat any blank answer as empty_generation in both paths; do not persist it.
acceptance: Echo provider returning '' gives non-empty fallback text, a degraded reason, and no empty history message

findings.title: Provider failover invisible in turn telemetry
findings.mechanism: Router counts fallbacks in a metric but CompletionResponse carries no attempts; kernel hard-codes fallbacks=0, so provider_fallback never fires.
findings.root_cause: Attempt list kept local to the router.
findings.recommended_fix: Carry attempts on CompletionResponse and the final stream chunk; set fallback_count and providers_attempted.
acceptance: Failing first provider -> fallback_count == 1 and provider_fallback in degraded_reasons

findings.title: Client keeps only degraded: bool
findings.mechanism: done frame sends degraded_reasons; TurnMeta stores only the boolean, so the UI cannot say why, and tainted-only turns are badged degraded.
findings.recommended_fix: Persist degraded_reasons and render per reason.

findings.title: /chat and /chat/stream run different pipelines
findings.mechanism: run uses the answer cache and the reasoner (possible multi-sample hidden passes); stream (the app's only path) uses neither; eval measures run.
findings.recommended_fix: Run the agent eval gate through stream (or both); document the divergence.
acceptance: Eval harness has a stream mode used by the gate
